blocks.text: We're building KiwiKind Broadband with a simple goal: make reliable internet more affordable, more transparent and easier for Kiwi households to understand.
We're still preparing. No plans, orders or payments are available.
KiwiKind is not yet an operating internet service provider. No prices, fibre availability, supplier arrangements or installation dates have been confirmed.
We're exploring ways to make broadband more affordable without confusing introductory prices or surprise charges.
Our aim is to offer fibre services through genuine New Zealand wholesale partners once agreements are in place.
We're developing a website and Android app designed to share customer information securely through one backend.
Your existing KiwiKind account uses the same customer portal and account system as the Android app. Sign in through our secure portal. Email registration remains closed during pre-launch.
Sign in to your existing account through the customer portal used by the website and Android app.
Follow future connection requests and updates. Availability and ordering remain disabled during pre-launch.
Keep conversations and request history together, with the same records available across devices.
This is a visual demonstration. No account information is loaded or stored.
Dashboard design preview only. Open the secure customer portal below to access your existing account. Broadband orders and payments remain disabled.

Account pages open on our secure Render customer portal. Sign up opens the existing registration page, but email registration is disabled while customer intake is closed. If the free server is waking up, allow a moment for the page to connect.
Design the website and Android app, and test a secure shared account system.
Confirm wholesale partnerships, actual costs, legal requirements and customer support arrangements.
Only publish pricing, coverage and ordering when they're backed by verified agreements.
Can I sign up for broadband today?
blocks.answer: Not yet. KiwiKind is a pre-launch project, not an operating internet service provider.
Affordable fibre is our goal. We cannot promise prices until wholesale costs and business requirements are confirmed.
An Android app is in development. It isn't available for public customer use yet.

blocks.text: Can I check availability or pay?
blocks.answer: No. Coverage checks, orders and payments are disabled until the service is ready.
